title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: capping a certificate-money transfer at the Current Balance
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to a Savings & Money Market Accounts account when the owner moves out, by telephone transfer to their own checking account, the money that the certificate of deposit which most recently paid into it put there. It fixes the amount moved once the net certificate money still held in the account is known.

## Policy clause

The amount moved is the net certificate money, capped at the account's Current Balance at the moment of the transfer, and rounded half-up to the cent.

Restated as a choice between two figures:

| Comparison at the moment of the transfer | Amount moved |
|---|---|
| net certificate money is greater than the Current Balance | the Current Balance, rounded half-up to the cent |
| net certificate money is equal to or less than the Current Balance | the net certificate money, rounded half-up to the cent |

In other words, the amount moved is the lower of the two figures, rounded half-up to the cent.

## Points of judgement

- **Which Current Balance?** The one the account shows at the moment of the transfer, after everything that has already posted to it, not the figure on the last statement.
- **Where rounding applies.** Rounding half-up to the cent is applied to the figure chosen, once.
- **Nothing beyond the account.** The cap means the transfer never asks for more than the account holds at that moment.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Net certificate money | Current Balance at the moment of the transfer | Amount moved | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 10040.00 | USD 8200.00 | USD 8200.00 | certificate money exceeds what the account holds, so the cap applies |
| USD 10040.00 | USD 12500.00 | USD 10040.00 | the account holds more than the certificate money; other money stays in the account |
| USD 732.405 | USD 900.00 | USD 732.41 | below the cap; half a cent rounds up |
| USD 0.00 | USD 900.00 | USD 0.00 | no certificate money remains |

**Wrong reading:** "The owner may move the whole Current Balance because the certificate paid into the account." **Correct basis:** only the net certificate money is moved; the Current Balance is a ceiling, not the amount.
